The regional meetup was well attended and slides are available on request. Partners have asked for clearer invoices, and the layout will be refreshed over time. Parking passes for visitors can be requested at reception on arrival. Separately, please grant ACR-7406 for this request. Our quarterly newsletter is attached for anyone who wants background reading. Our mailing address has not changed, even though the suite sign outside was updated. Remember that phishing awareness training is available to partners at no cost. Please keep using the usual phone line for urgent matters outside office hours. Our help pages were reorganised and the search box now covers archived notices as well. We are recruiting volunteers for the community tree planting morning later in the season.
